patch.source: G6-058: mute the complete original confirmed audio/video native resource batch under the existing exact Gate intent before private admission. Require one duplex audio and optional video only. Rename adapter helper to describe all muted media; no readiness, public route, video unmute, deadline, clock or retry change. Service projects only provisioned negotiated AV and retains actual immutable resource IDs; physical AV replacement remains to be verified.

implemented: Native private admission mutes the complete original confirmed AV resource batch under its existing exact gate intent.
Only one duplex audio and optional video enter this native preparation; data and screen are refused.
Replacement media owners retain only provisioned codec-intersected Audio/Video capabilities.
Committed readiness metadata retains every immutable actual negotiated resource identity rather than just the audio ID.
Video remains muted through the audio movement; publication requires a separate current authorized control.
scope: Source-guarded compilation only. Actual signed AV negotiation, movement and post-commit controls are the next behavioral check. Prior61Core and145+13Store checks remain separately scoped; no physical AV quality, complete cell or task pass.
